args: import sympy as s; I=s.I; q=s.symbols('q0:9', real=True); t=s.symbols('t', real=True); R=s.Matrix(3,3,q); z=s.Rational(4,5)+I*s.Rational(3,5); a=s.Matrix([t,2,3]); b=s.Matrix([[2,1,1]]); Y=R+z*a*b; H=s.expand(Y*Y.H); outs=[H[i,i] for i in range(3)]+[s.re(H[i,j]) for i,j in [(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)]]+[s.im(H[i,j]) for i,j in [(0,1),(0,2),(1,2)]]; J=s.Matrix(outs).jacobian(list(q)+[t]); sub={q[0]:1,q[4]:2,q[8]:4,t:1,**{q[i]:0 for i in [1,2,3,5,6,7]}}; A=J.subs(sub); print(A.rank()); print([s.factor(A[:,cols].det()) for cols in [list(range(9)),list(range(8))+[9]]])
